rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Nordax provides AI agents with access to a network of over 360,000 cryptographically verified business entity profiles. Each entity includes trust scores, Schema.org structured data, and W3C verifiable credentials, enabling AI systems to discover, verify, and reason about businesses in real time. The server requires no API key; data depth varies by entity tier.
